name: cc-mod-trimtab
description: wen-hsiu hsu's Claude Code mods: fewer mistakes, fewer tokens, more fault tolerance

plugins.name: all
plugins.description: Installs every mod at once, secret-scrub first; uninstall any you do not want

plugins.name: subagent-dispatch
plugins.description: Shows running background agents above the prompt box and re-dispatches interrupted ones in one press

plugins.name: self-check
plugins.description: Guard-rail reminders for Claude: when the same tool fails twice in a row for the same reason it is asked to find the cause first; when it says done after editing code without verifying, the stop is blocked once

plugins.name: open-items
plugins.description: Keeps unresolved questions, pending decisions and deferred items outside the context, reminds you above the prompt box, and quotes one in a press

plugins.name: output-trimmer
plugins.description: When a Bash command prints too much, the model gets only the head, the tail and the error lines; the full output is saved to a file

plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Distills the conversation in the background into project memory (the built-in memory) and a progress file; a rule confirmed in several sessions is proposed to you before it goes into CLAUDE.md, and a procedure becomes a project skill

plugins.name: secret-scrub
plugins.description: Masks tokens, API keys and other secrets before a prompt is sent, so they stay out of the transcript and the prompt cache

plugins.name: session-keeper
plugins.description: Shows the prompt cache state above the prompt box on desktop; reads the cache once when idle so a 1h cache does not expire

plugins.name: tool-guard
plugins.description: Holds commands that lose work (git, rm, migrations), previews what they would change and lets you decide; checks commit subject format and removes the Claude trailer
